result.summary: Adds test vectors to script_tests.json and tx_invalid.json for script interpreter and transaction validation edge cases. The additions cover OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with negative operand -2, OP_IFDUP on negative zero and non-minimal zero, OP_ROLL with identical values on stack, Taproot output keys with invalid curve x-coordinates, and single-flag execution for STRICTENC, LOW_S, and NULLFAIL.
result.problem: Downstream and alternate implementations that rely on Bitcoin Core's static test suite can miss subtle consensus and policy interpreter edge cases. Additionally, certain policy behaviors were previously only exercised when Bitcoin Core's test harness dynamically augmented validation flags, leaving static JSON consumers without direct test coverage.
evidence: Author note in description: 'These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)'
Author note in commit message: 'Some policy cases were only caught by the tx_valid harness adding flags back, which implementations copying the JSON don't replicate.'
result.card: Adds test vectors to script_tests.json and tx_invalid.json covering interpreter edge cases including OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with -2, OP_IFDUP on negative zero, invalid Taproot public key x-coordinates, and isolated policy flags. Alternate implementations consuming Bitcoin Core's static test vectors miss these corner cases, particularly where Bitcoin Core's test harness previously relied on dynamic flag injection. The edge cases were identified by finding gaps in bitcoin-s.

risk.why: Only modifies static JSON test data files and does not change any production or validation code.
